events.verdict: O'Neale (PHX) reaches in and the contact with George's (UTA) back is marginal.
George (UTA) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before passing.
Williams (PHX) makes illegal contact to Kessler's (UTA) arm during the shot attempt.
Gillespie (PHX) briefly brings his hands to George's (UTA) body as he attempts to establish a legal guarding position in George's path.
Markkanen (UTA) reaches in and initiates contact with Williams' (PHX) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
O'Neale (PHX) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Markkanen (UTA) in the post.
Williams (PHX) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Markkanen's (UTA) shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) initiates illegal contact with George's (UTA) arm.
Williams (PHX) firms up in a screening position and does not deliver contact to Mykhailiuk (UTA).
Mykhailiuk (UTA) has a hand placed on Booker (PHX), which he immediately removes as Booker receives the ball and enters his upward shooting motion.
O'Neale (PHX)  reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Markkanen's (UTA) arm.

Replay review of the foul called on O'Neale (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. O'Neal (PHX) reaches in and makes legal contact with the ball as he ties up Markkanen (UTA). There is no proximate foul by Markkanen on the play. Since neither player has possession at the point of interruption, play resumes with a jump ball.
Mykhailiuk (UTA) grabs Booker (PHX) around the waist. The illegal contact occurs before Booker starts his upward shooting motion and a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.
Williams (PHX) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Booker (PHX) legally contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Markkanen's (UTA) arm.
O'Neale (PHX) moves forward into George's (UTA) path and initiates body contact, which affects his driving shot attempt.

Clayton Jr. (UTA) slides his arm off of Booker (PHX) at the end of his drive and does not affect his SQBR. Although Kessler (UTA) jumps toward Booker, he lands in front of him and does not initiate illegal contact.
Kessler (UTA) makes contact with the ball before it enters the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Booker (PHX) jumps forward in pursuit of the loose ball and initiates body to body contact with Markkanen (UTA) that affects his SQBR.
George (UTA) directly contests Booker's (PHX) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Booker's hand after the release.
Kessler (UTA) makes contact to Williams' (PHX) wrist while he is in possession of the ball, affecting his shot attempt near the rim.
Clayton Jr. (UTA) reaches in and initiates contact with Williams' (PHX) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Allen (PHX) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Markkanen's (UTA) arm.
